metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.7 · 1978 · Halloween
metas.description: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois, to kill again.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.5 · 1981 · Halloween II
metas.description: While Dr. Loomis hunts for Michael Myers, a traumatized Laurie is rushed to Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, and The Shape is not far behind her.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.2 · 1982 · Halloween III: Season of the Witch
metas.description: Kids all over America want Silver Shamrock masks for Halloween. Doctor Daniel Challis seeks to uncover a plot by Silver Shamrock owner Conal Cochran.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 5.8 · 1988 · Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers
metas.description: Ten years after his original massacre, the invalid Michael Myers awakens on Halloween Eve and returns to Haddonfield to kill his seven-year-old niece. Can Dr. Loomis stop him?

metas.name: 5 · ★ 4.9 · 1989 · Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers
metas.description: One year after the events of Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers (1988), the Shape returns to Haddonfield once again in an attempt to kill his now-mute niece.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 4.6 · 1995 · Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
metas.description: Six years after Michael Myers last terrorized Haddonfield, he returns there in pursuit of his niece, Jamie Lloyd, who has escaped with her newborn child, for which Michael and a mysterious cult have sinister plans.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 5.8 · 1998 · Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
metas.description: Laurie Strode, now the dean of a Northern California private school with an assumed name, must battle the Shape one last time, as the life of her own son hangs in the balance.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 3.9 · 2002 · Halloween: Resurrection
metas.description: Three years after he last terrorized his sister, Michael Myers confronts her again, before traveling to Haddonfield to deal with the cast and crew of a reality show which is being broadcast from his old home.

metas.name: 9 · ★ 6.1 · 2007 · Halloween
metas.description: After being committed for 15 years, Michael Myers, now a grown man and still very dangerous, escapes from the mental institution and immediately returns to Haddonfield to find his baby sister, Laurie.

metas.name: 10 · ★ 4.8 · 2009 · Halloween II
metas.description: Laurie Strode struggles to come to terms with her brother Michael's deadly return to Haddonfield, Illinois; meanwhile, Michael prepares for another reunion with his sister.
